# Both passes of a check of group 3 of 20, whose one data pack had 21 bytes
# overwritten in its middle: one line per damaged pack, restic's repair hint
# with the pack's full id, then "Fatal: repository contains errors", exit code 1.
# Pass 2 says the same after "create exclusive lock for repository".
$ restic --cache-dir /tmp/pocketcloud-check-cache --cleanup-cache --no-lock check --read-data-subset=3/20

[0:00] 100.00%  1 / 1 packs

The repository contains damaged pack files. These damaged files must be removed to repair the repository. This can be done using the following commands. Please read the troubleshooting guide at https://restic.readthedocs.io/en/stable/077_troubleshooting.html first.

restic repair packs b6597323646d9a1a0b87300c57c625cffe338cb24e7cc9a47a680d320c992870
restic repair snapshots --forget

Damaged pack files can be caused by backend problems, hardware problems or bugs in restic. Please open an issue at https://github.com/restic/restic/issues/new/choose for further troubleshooting!
Fatal: repository contains errors
--- exit 1
